extracted.name: SECRETS INGREDIENTS to Making Crispy Banana Fritters •AUTHENTIC RECIPE •Kluay-Tod
extracted.description: 🟠Full Recipe Here: https://youtu.be/qCZ6II-d3Cs Today I’ll show you how to make famous Thai street food dessert of Kuay Tod or deep fried banana I made this recipe in Bangkok so I could show you the Authentic Recipe
instruction_lines: In this recipe I use original Thai banana but you can use Cavendish banana in this recipe we use not too ripe banana that still have some green on the skin as shown

Mix all ingredients below together ** The special ingredient for this recipe is this coconut meat which is use to make coconut milk and cream if you can not find this meat no need to add -another special ingredient in this recipe is Red Lime Stone or in Thai Nam pun Sai you can try find in your local Thai Supermarket
To test consistency dip finger as shown -then coat banana in the batter
Deep fry banana one by one until golden and crispy as shown
Done..!! 😋😋serve with fried pandan leave for more aroma
